entities.summary: Sophia Cathedral, a notable figure in the history of Ukraine, associated with Kievan Rus' & Kyiv as Capital (1015–1132). Preceded by Yaroslav the Wise & Kievan Golden Age and Baptism of Rus' in Kyiv under Volodymyr the Great. Their legacy influenced Fragmentation & Galicia-Volhynia.
